svg.text: registerFlight(f) → builds ONE SeatInventory per flight
NO global lock anywhere in this class ✓
seat safety is delegated entirely to SeatInventory CAS
AutoCloseable so the sweeper thread actually dies
honest: bookings live in a map — no persistence, no PNR reuse
payment is out of scope; confirm() is not a charge
THE CONCURRENCY CORE — lock-free per seat
status: SlotStatus · bookingId: PNR · holdExpiry: Instant
status + owner + expiry swapped as ONE reference — never torn
CAS loop: eligible if AVAILABLE or an EXPIRED hold
confirm(seatNo, pnr): boolean — CAS HELD(pnr) → BOOKED
release(seatNo, pnr): boolean — only the OWNER may release
sweepExpired(now): List<String> — CAS stale HELD → AVAILABLE
every mutation is compare-and-set + retry — zero mutexes
exactly one of N racers wins a seat; different seats never contend ✓
expired-hold-is-available makes the sweeper an optimisation,
occupancy map is sized at construction — no seat is ever added later
THE SEAMS — two Strategy axes + Observer
surges as the cabin fills / departure nears
swap the fare rule, orchestrator untouched
lowest row first — fills the cabin forward
window columns first, then the rest
drives holdAnySeat() only — a pick can still lose the CAS
new channel = new observer, subject never changes
honest: both print to console, not real gateways
observers run on the caller's thread — keep them fast
search is read-only — never touches SeatInventory
honest: single-leg only, no connections or fare classes
multi-hop search would be a graph problem, not this class
THE MODEL — seat map + Booking with a State
Flight: number, origin, destination, departure, aircraft
cabin(FIRST, rows, cols) → rows numbered continuously
Seat: number, row, column, seatClass — IMMUTABLE
Seat carries NO availability field — that lives in
SeatInventory, so seats stay shareable & cache-friendly ✓
confirm() · cancel() · expire() — all delegate to state
status(): BookingStatus (derived from the state object)
the entity validates itself — no status switch in the service
PNR is the identity; seat + flight are the reservation
HeldState → confirm / cancel / expire all legal
a CONFIRMED booking can never be expired by the sweeper
SeatInventory is built from Aircraft.seats(); Booking is issued per hold

g.text: WHY CAS AND NOT A LOCK?
A seat has exactly one owner, so the
contended unit is a single reference.
compareAndSet gives mutual exclusion
on that reference with no blocking,
no thread parking, no lock ordering.
Losers retry or bail — nobody waits.
TWO-LEVEL TTL
EAGER: a daemon sweeper CASes stale
holds back to AVAILABLE and drives
their Bookings to EXPIRED.
LAZY: tryHold treats an expired hold
as free and CASes straight over it.
A stale hold never blocks a real booker.
